title: A/R Summary has no Collapse all button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer with an open invoice on today's date, so the report has rows.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Look at the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Hover over that cell.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is no chevron button: the report has no groups.

Step 2:

  • No "Collapse all" or "Expand all" tooltip shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)
